H300.def: from «0251» and «07837»; brother of (the) dawn; Achishachar, an Israelite:--Ahishar.

H301.def: from «0251» and «07891»; brother of (the) singer; Achishar, an Israelite:--Ahishar.

H302.def: from «0251» and «08602»; brother of folly; Achithophel, an Israelite:--Ahithophel.

H303.def: from the same root as «02459»; fatness (i.e. fertile); Achlab, a place in Palestine:--Ahlab.

H304.def: the same as «0305»; wishful; Achlai, the name of an Israelitess and of an Israelite:--Ahlai.

H305.et: probably from (0253) and a variation of (03863)
H305.def: or achaley {akh-al-ay'}; prob from «0253» and a variation of «03863»; would that!:--O that, would God.

H306.def: perhaps from «02492» (and thus dream-stone); a gem, probably the amethyst:--amethyst.

H307.def: of Persian derivation; Achmetha (i.e. Ecbatana), the summer capital of Persia:--Achmetha.

H308.def: of uncertain derivation; Achasbai, an Israelite:--Ahasbai.

H309.def: a primitive root; to loiter (i.e. be behind); by implication to procrastinate:--continue, defer, delay, hinder, be late (slack), stay (there), tarry (longer).

H310.def: from «0309»; properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses):--after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, + out (over) live, + persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with.

H312.def: from «0309»; properly, hinder; generally, next, other, etc.:--(an-)other man, following, next, strange.

H313.def: the same as «0312»; Acher, an Israelite:--Aher.

H314.def: or (shortened) ;acharon {akh-ar-one'}; from «0309»; hinder; generally, late or last; specifically (as facing the east) western:--after (-ward), to come, following, hind(-er, -ermost, -most), last, latter, rereward, ut(ter)most.

H315.def: from «0310» and «0251»; after (his) brother: Achrach, an Israelite:--Aharah.

H316.def: from «0310» and «02426»; behind (the) intrenchment (i.e. safe); Acharchel, an Israelite:--Aharhel,

H319.def: from «0310»; the last or end, hence, the future; also posterity:--(last, latter) end (time), hinder (utter) -most, length, posterity, remnant, residue, reward.

H323.def: of Persian derivation; a satrap or governor of a main province (of Persia):--lieutenant.

H325.def: or (shortened) pAchashrosh {akh- ash-rosh'} (Esth. 10:1); of Persian origin; Achashverosh (i.e. Ahasuerus or Artaxerxes, but in this case Xerxes), the title (rather than name) of a Persian king:--Ahasuerus.

H326.def: probably of Persian derivation; an achastarite (i.e. courier); the designation (rather than name) of an Israelite:--Haakashtari (includ. the article).

H328.et: from an unused root perhaps meaning to move softly
H328.def: from an unused root perhaps meaning to move softly; (as a noun) a necromancer (from their soft incantations), (as an adverb) gently:--charmer, gently, secret, softly.

H329.et: from an unused root probably meaning to pierce or make fast
H329.def: from an unused root probably meaning to pierce or make fast; a thorn-tree (especially the buckthorn):--Atad, bramble, thorn.

H330.et: from an unused root (probably meaning to bind)
H330.def: from an unused root (probably meaning to bind); properly, twisted (yarn), i.e. tapestry:--fine linen.

H331.def: a primitive root; to close (the lips or ears); by analology to contract (a window by bevelled jambs):--narrow, shut, stop.

H332.def: a primitive root; to close up:--shut.

H333.def: from «0332»; maimed; Ater, the name of three Israelites:--Ater.

H334.def: from «0332»; shut up, i.e. impeded (as to the use of the right hand):--+ left-handed.

H335.def: perhaps from «0370»; where? hence how?:--how, what, whence, where, whether, which (way).

H336.et: probably identical with (0335) (through the idea of a query)
H336.def: probably identical with «0335» (through the idea of a query); not:--island (Job 22:30).

H338.et: probably identical with (0337) (through the idea of a doleful sound)
H338.def: probably identical with «0337» (through the idea of a doleful sound); a howler (used only in the plural), i.e. any solitary wild creature; --wild beast of the islands.

H339.def: from «0183»; properly, a habitable spot (as desirable); dry land, a coast, an island:--country, isle, island.

H340.def: a primitive root; to hate (as one of an opposite tribe or party); hence to be hostile:--be an enemy.

H341.def: or (fully) owyeb {o-yabe'}; active participle of «0340»; hating; an adversary:--enemy, foe.

H343.et: from the same as (0181) (in the sense of bending down)
H343.def: from the same as «0181» (in the sense of bending down); oppression; by implication misfortune, ruin:--calamity, destruction.

H344.def: perhaps from «0337»; the screamer, i.e. a hawk:--kite, vulture.

H345.def: the same as «0344»; Ajah, the name of two Israelites:--Aiah, Ajah.

H347.def: from «0340»; hated (i.e. persecuted); Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience:--Job.

H348.def: from «0336» and «02083»; Izebel, the wife of king Ahab:--Jezebel.

H349.def: also eykah {ay-kaw'}; and teykakah {ay-kaw'-kah}; prolonged from «0335»; how? or how!; also where:--how, what.

H350.def: from «0336» and «03519»; (there is) no glory, i.e. inglorious; Ikabod, a son of Phineas:--I-chabod.

H351.et: probably a variation for (0349), but not as an interrogative
H351.def: probably a variation for «0349», but not as an interogative; where:--where.

H352.def: from the same as «0193»; properly, strength; hence, anything strong; specifically a chief (politically); also a ram (from his strength); a pilaster (as a strong support); an oak or other strong tree:--mighty (man), lintel, oak, post, ram, tree.

H354.et: an intensive form of (0352) (in the sense of ram)
H354.def: an intensive form of «0352» (in the sense of ram); a stag or male deer:--hart.

H355.def: feminine of «0354»; a doe or female deer:--hind.

H356.def: or (shortened) ;Elown {ay-lone'}; or Eylon {ay- lone'}; from «0352»; oak-grove; Elon, the name of a place in Palestine, and also of one Hittite, two Israelites:--Elon.

H357.def: from «0354»; deer-field; Ajalon, the name of five places in Palestine:--Aijalon, Ajalon.

H358.def: from «0356», «01004», and «02603»; oak-grove of (the) house of favor; Elon of Beth-chanan, a place in Palestine:--Elon-beth-hanan.

H359.def: or mEylath {ay-lath'}; from «0352»; trees or a grove (i.e. palms); Eloth or Elath, a place on the Red Sea:--Elath, Eloth.

H360.def: feminine of «0353»; power; by implication, protection:--strength.

H361.def: or (shortened) ;elam {ay-lawm'}; or (feminine) ielammah {ay-lam-maw'}; probably from «0352»; a pillar-space (or colonnade), i.e. a pale (or portico):--arch.

H362.def: plural of «0352»; palm-trees; Elim, a place in the Desert:--Elim.

H364.def: from «0352» and «06290»; oak of Paran; El- Paran, a portion of the district of Paran:--El-paran.

H365.def: the same as «0355»; a doe:--hind, Aijeleth.

H366.et: from an unused root (meaning to frighten)
H366.def: from an unused root (meaning to frighten); frightful:--terrible.

H367.def: or (shortened) remah {ay-maw'}; from the same as «0366»; fright; concrete, an idol (as a bugbear):--dread, fear, horror, idol, terrible, terror.

H368.def: plural of «0367»; terrors; Emim, an early Canaanitish (or Maobitish) tribe:--Emims.

H369.et: as if from a primitive root meaning to be nothing or not exist
H369.def: as if from a primitive root meaning to be nothing or not exist; a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle:--else, except, fail, (father-)less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare «0370».

H370.et: probably identical with (0369) in the sense of query (compare (0336))
H370.def: probably identical with «0369» in the sense of query (compare «0336»); --where? (only in connection with prepositional prefix, whence):--whence, where.

H371.def: apparently a shortened form of «0369»; but (like «0370») an interrogative: is it not?:--not.

H372.def: from «0336» and «05828»; helpless; Iezer, an Israelite:--Jeezer.

H373.def: patronymic from «0372»; an Iezrite or descendant of Iezer:--Jezerite.

H374.def: or (shortened) ephah {ay-faw'}; of Egyptian derivation; an ephah or measure for grain; hence, a measure in general:-- ephah, (divers) measure(-s).

H375.def: from «0335» and «06311»; what place?; also (of time) when?; or (of means) how?; --what manner, where.

H376.et: contracted for (0582) [or perhaps rather from an unused root meaning to be extant]
H376.def: contracted for «0582» (or perhaps rather from an unused root meaning to be extant); a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation):--also, another, any (man), a certain, + champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-)man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), + none, one, people, person, + steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare «0802».

H377.def: denominative from «0376»; to be a man, i.e. act in a manly way:--show (one) self a man.

H378.def: from «0376» and «01322»; man of shame; Ish- Bosheth, a son of King Saul:--Ish-bosheth.

H379.def: from «0376» and «01935»; man of renown; Ishod, an Israelite:--Ishod.

H380.def: diminutive from «0376»; the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence, the middle (of night):--apple (of the eye), black, obscure.

H381.def: from «0376» and «02428»; man of might; by defect. transcription (2 Sam. 23:20) Iysh-Chay {eesh-khah'ee}; as if from «0376» and «02416»; living man; Ish-chail (or Ish-chai), an Israelite:--a valiant man.

H382.def: from «0376» and «02897»; man of Tob; Ish-Tob, a place in Palestine:--Ish-tob.

H383.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03426»; properly, entity; used only as a particle of affirmation, there is:--art thou, can, do ye, have, it be, there is (are), × we will not.

H384.def: perhaps from «0837» and «0410»; God has arrived; Ithiel, the name of an Israelite, also of a symbolical person:--Ithiel.

H385.def: from «0339» and «08558»; coast of the palm-tree; Ithamar, a son of Aaron:--Ithamar.

H386.et: from an unused root (meaning to continue)
H386.def: or (shortened) ethan {ay-thawn'}; from an unused root (meaning to continue); permanence; hence (concrete) permanent; specifically a chieftain:--hard, mighty, rough, strength, strong.

H387.def: the same as «0386»; permanent; Ethan, the name of four Israelites:--Ethan.

H388.def: plural of «0386»; always with the article; the permanent brooks; Ethanim, the name of a month:--Ethanim.

H389.def: akin to «0403»; a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only:--also, in any wise, at least, but, certainly, even, howbeit, nevertheless, notwithstanding, only, save, surely, of a surety, truly, verily, + wherefore, yet (but).

H390.et: from an unused root probably meaning to strengthen
H390.def: from an unused root probably meaning to strengthen; a fortress; Accad, a place in Babylon:--Accad.

H391.def: from «03576»; falsehood; by implication treachery:--liar, lie.

H392.def: from «0391»; deceitful (in the sense of a winter- torrent which fails in summer); Akzib, the name of two places in Palestine:--Achzib.

H393.et: from an unused root (apparently meaning to act harshly)
H393.def: from an unused root (apparently meaning to act harshly); violent; by implication deadly; also (in a good sense) brave:--cruel, fierce.

H396.def: feminine from «0398»; something eatable, i.e. food:--meat.

H397.def: of uncertain derivation; Akish, a Philistine king:--Achish.

H398.def: a primitive root; to eat (literally or figuratively):--X at all, burn up, consume, devour(-er, up), dine, eat(-er, up), feed (with), food, × freely, × in...wise(-deed, plenty), (lay) meat, × quite.
